ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Mars

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Venus retrograde in your daily routine sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Venus retrograde in your home and family sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Venus retrograde in your money sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Venus retrograde in your inner life sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Venus retrograde in your career sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
From {H:1794515238000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Venus retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.
